problem_statement: Build a brand-new /solutions page from scratch on this Nuxt 3 landing site (nuxt-ui-templates__landing). The route /solutions does not exist yet (baseline is empty). The site's shared chrome (AppHeader with Features/Metrics nav + AppFooter with 'Built with Nuxt UI') lives in the default layout — your new page must reuse that layout so nav+footer match every sibling page. Construct a 'Solutions for every team' page using the site's design system (dark colorMode, lime primary, UContainer/UButton, border-default/bg-default/text-dimmed tokens): a hero (eyebrow 'Solutions', h1 'Solutions for every team', lead paragraph), an audience switcher with three tab buttons (Engineering / SRE / Product), a 3-card solution grid that swaps its cards when a different audience tab is clicked (Engineering shows 'Ship with Confidence', SRE shows 'Defend Your SLOs'), and a closing CTA with a 'Start for free' link. Default active audience is Engineering. Must be responsive with zero horizontal overflow at 390px.
required_content: Shared default layout reused: AppHeader nav links Features + Metrics, AppFooter 'Built with Nuxt UI' — identical to sibling home page
Hero eyebrow 'Solutions' + h1 'Solutions for every team' + lead paragraph
Audience switcher: three tab buttons Engineering / SRE / Product, each carrying data-aud, Engineering active by default
Engineering solution grid: h3 cards 'Ship with Confidence', 'Debug in Minutes', 'Own Your Services'
Client-side interaction: clicking the SRE tab swaps the grid to SRE cards ('Defend Your SLOs', 'Tame the Pager', 'Capacity Ahead of Demand') with no reload
Closing CTA section with a 'Start for free' link
design_constraints: Reuse the site design system: dark colorMode, lime primary color, UContainer/UButton components, border-default/bg-default/text-dimmed tokens, font-mono uppercase tracking eyebrow

Palette (from reference): near-black page background #09090b (dark colorMode, mean luminance ~15/255, do NOT render a light theme), lime primary accent rgb(200,240,49) / #c8f031 used for the primary CTA/active state, muted zinc borders and dimmed text; keep the page visibly dark with the lime accent present

Layout structure (top to bottom): shared AppHeader nav, then a hero block (font-mono uppercase eyebrow, large h1, lead paragraph), then a horizontal audience switcher row of three tab buttons, then a 3-card grid below the switcher, then a closing CTA section, then shared AppFooter
Reuse the shared default layout (AppHeader + AppFooter) so cross-page chrome is consistent with the home page
No remote fetches / no <Icon> (Iconify online) on the new page — keep console clean offline
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /solutions (layout:false 空 stub); reference 完整实现; bad = reference 去掉 audience tab 的 @click 处理器 → 点击 SRE tab 无反应,grid 永远停在 Engineering → 只失 interaction_assertions 这一个目标 gate。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同(仅 pages/solutions.vue 不同;app.vue+layouts/default.vue 三份一致的 chrome 重构)。跨页一致性以 dom_assertions 绑定 shared nav(Features/Metrics)+footer('Built with Nuxt UI')于 desktop_solutions 与 sibling desktop_home 两态 (#18ag)。
